description: The fix plan for a site's AI visibility, most important first: what to change, why it matters for being named in AI answers, how many points of the score it should recover, the pages it applies to, and a paste-ready file or snippet when there is one (llms.txt, robots.txt rules, Organization schema). Free from the identity reading, no account; signed in, it is built from your latest finished audit of that site, which covers the answer engines too.

limit.description: Fixes, most important first, per page, default 12

offset.description: The nextOffset of the previous answer

url.description: A public website, e.g. example.com or https://example.com
